reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: These are my favourite pimple patches so far. I’ve reordered them several times already. They work really well and do what they’re supposed to do. Must say that they’re not clear and are visible on the skin (i personally don’t care about it so it’s not a problem for me.) they also stick really well but might fall off if you put them in places that tend to move a lot (like near the mouth)
reviews.zh: 到目前為止呢啲係我最鍾意嘅暗瘡貼。我已經回購咗好幾次。佢哋work得好好，做到應有嘅效果。要講嘅係佢哋唔透明，貼喺皮膚上會見到（我自己就唔介意，所以對我嚟講唔係問題）。佢哋黏得好實，但如果貼喺郁動得比較多嘅位置（好似嘴附近）可能會跌

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: These spot treatment stickers are truly excellent. They have become a trusted and regular purchase for me over the past six years. I've found them to be incredibly effective for my acne. It's wonderful to have a product I can rely on - a visible difference over night.
reviews.zh: 呢啲暗瘡貼真係好正。過去六年嚟佢哋已經係我信賴同定期回購嘅產品。對我嘅暗瘡非常有效。可以有一支信得過嘅產品真係好——過夜就有明顯分別。

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text:
Love these pimple patches. 
I've been using all sorts but I like how you get multiple sizes in the master patch set
I can't really use it during the day but it works well over night and always draws out the gross from my white heads
reviews.zh:
好鍾意呢啲暗瘡貼。
我乜嘢都試過，但好鍾意 master patch set 有齊唔同 size。
我日頭真係用唔到，但過夜用效果好好，總係可以將白頭嘅污糟嘢吸出嚟

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: Llego el pedido. Afortunadamente y desafortunadamente me salieron dos espantosas espinillas, aplique los parches y esperare a ver como resulta, pero hasta el momento lo que puedo decir es que es muy sencillo colocarlos y no se notan casi nada, de hecho ocultan la espinilla y si aplicas maquillaje no se notara, yo solo aplique bloqueador.
reviews.zh: 到貨啦。好彩又好唔好彩，我生咗兩粒好恐怖嘅暗瘡，貼咗暗瘡貼，等緊睇下效果，但到目前為止我可以講嘅係好容易貼，而且幾乎睇唔到出嚟，實際上遮住咗粒瘡，搽化妝品嘅話都唔會見到，我只係搽咗防曬。

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: I have been using the COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch for about 2 months now, and I have been very impressed with the results. I have noticed that my pimples heal much faster when I use the patch, and I am less likely to get scars. The patch is also very comfortable to wear, and I can barely feel it on my skin. I have not experienced any breakouts or irritation while using this patch, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a product to help heal pimples.
reviews.zh: 我用 COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 大概 2 個月，效果令我好深刻。我留意到用咗貼之後暗瘡好得快好多，而且留疤嘅機會都低咗。貼住都好舒服，貼喺皮膚上幾乎feel唔到。使用期間冇爆瘡或者刺激，絕對推薦畀任何想搵產品幫助暗瘡癒合嘅人。

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: This patch works okay on pimples. This one pimple on the side of my cheeks took about 7-8 patches to fully go away. The downside is the patch doesn’t stick well and very visible, so it’s not really practical to wear to go to work or school with makeup.
reviews.zh: 呢個貼用喺暗瘡上效果一般。面頰側邊有粒暗瘡，用咗 7-8 粒先至完全消退。缺點係貼唔實，而且好明顯，所以要化妝返工返學嘅話唔係好實用。

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: As many reviewers have pointed out, these patches (and most patches tbh) only work on pimples that have a white head and not hidden ones. These are convenient for using before going to bed, but a bit noticeable when you go out. Still a great value product.
reviews.zh: 好似好多評論者都指出，呢啲貼（講真大部分貼都係）只對有白頭嘅暗瘡有效，對於冇白頭嘅就冇用。瞓覺前用好方便，但出街就會比較明顯。仍然係性價比好高嘅產品。

reviews.shade: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 24 Count
reviews.text: I have been using the COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch and it is the best that I have used compared to other similar items from other brands. Although the COSRX patch is a bit "thicker" and not as transparent or thin compared to other brands' - it is the BEST at pulling out whiteheads and bacteria from POPPED pimples. It also has very good adhesive and stays on the skin. I will repurchase over and over again
reviews.zh: 我用緊 COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch，相比其他牌子嘅同類產品，係我用過最好嘅。雖然 COSRX 嘅貼比較「厚」，冇其他牌子咁透明或者薄——但佢最勁嘅係可以將唧咗出嚟嘅暗瘡嘅白頭同細菌吸出嚟。黏力都好好，可以貼實喺皮膚度。我會一直回購落去

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
